nodes.label: Machine Learning
nodes.definition: Computers learning patterns from data rather than following explicit rules

nodes.label: Supervised Learning
nodes.definition: Training using data that does not require labels

nodes.label: Classification
nodes.definition: Predicting a discrete category, such as spam or not spam

nodes.label: Regression
nodes.definition: Predicting a continuous value, such as a house price

nodes.label: Clustering
nodes.definition: Grouping similar data points; every unsupervised learning task is a clustering task

nodes.label: Reinforcement Learning
nodes.definition: An agent learns by interacting with an environment and receiving rewards

nodes.label: Deep Learning
nodes.definition: Machine learning with neural networks that have many layers

nodes.label: Feedback
nodes.definition: The signal a model learns from
